name: Paws at You
tagline: Turn one pet photo into a five-second vertical video of that animal reaching a paw toward the camera.
description: Paws at You is an independent, fan-made tool that turns one photo of your pet into an approximately five-second vertical video of that animal reaching a paw toward the camera. You pick one of four poses, with no prompt to write. A separate in-browser PNG meme editor is free and needs no account. Video generation uses credits and is paid.
